This is a senior-level software engineering role on Pantheon's connectivity and API platform team, building the unified API layer behind their cloud WebOps product's dashboard and public API. The work centers on a federated GraphQL supergraph with Go subgraphs, breaking a large legacy Python monolith into bounded services, and owning the Cassandra data layer along with workflow orchestration on GCP Workflows, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Run. Core technologies are Go, GraphQL federation, gRPC and REST, Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Terraform, and observability tooling like Prometheus and Grafana, with some Rust and Python in the mix.
